content.value_statement: CloudBase projects need correct platform choices before implementation. This skill guides capability selection, console navigation, permissions, authentication, and deployment checks.
actual_capabilities: Routes CloudBase tasks to web, auth, mini program, functions, storage, database, and HTTP API skills.
Explains differences between static hosting, cloud storage, cloud functions, CloudRun, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL.
Guides use of CloudBase MCP tools for environment, domain, hosting, storage, permissions, and data model tasks.
Provides console URL patterns for common CloudBase management pages.
Defines safety checks for code changes, deployments, domains, and public exposure.
Highlights authentication and permission differences for web and mini program projects.
limitations: It is a platform guide, not a complete implementation recipe for each service.
It relies on current CloudBase MCP tools and console paths being available.
It does not validate live account permissions, quotas, or billing status.
Specialized code work should use the referenced implementation skills after routing.

use_cases.title: Choose a CloudBase Architecture
use_cases.description: Select CloudBase functions, storage, database, and permission models before writing implementation code.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Deployment Path
use_cases.description: Check CloudRun, hosting, custom domain, HTTPS, and public exposure requirements before deployment.

use_cases.title: Map Product Requirements to Services
use_cases.description: Compare Web, Mini Program, authentication, database, and console workflows for a new CloudBase feature.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose the right CloudBase service for this requirement: [describe the feature]. Explain the tradeoffs and next skill to use.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Auth Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare CloudBase Web and Mini Program authentication for my app. Identify the correct login method, permission model, and common mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Deployment Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the CloudBase deployment checks for this project: [describe hosting, domain, CloudRun, or public functions]. List blockers and confirmations.

prompt_templates.title: Review Platform Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this CloudBase architecture for service mismatch, permission risk, auth confusion, temporary URL misuse, and missing console steps: [describe architecture].

output_examples.input: I need users to upload private documents and view them later.
output: Recommendation: Use Cloud Storage, not static hosting.
Use temporary URLs for private access unless public read is required.
Configure storage security rules before writing upload code.

output_examples.input: I want to bind a domain with an SSL certificate.
output: Recommendation: Use the custom domain workflow, not the security domain workflow.
Confirm plan support, ICP filing, and certificate ID before binding.
Provide the CloudBase console link after the operation is complete.

output_examples.input: My Web app needs user-created orders in a database.
output: Recommendation: Use custom database rules for user ownership.
Avoid admin-only permissions for Web SDK writes.
Use cloud functions for cross-collection operations when needed.

best_practices: Start with platform selection before changing code, permissions, or deployment settings.
Resolve environment aliases to full environment IDs before generating links or SDK settings.
Complete deployment gate checks before public exposure, custom domains, CloudRun, or publishing.
anti_patterns: Using this overview skill after the exact implementation area is already clear.
Mixing Web and Mini Program authentication flows in one design.
Treating temporary storage URLs as permanent public URLs.

faq.question: Is this skill for writing CloudBase application code?
faq.answer: It helps choose the right CloudBase capability before implementation. Use specialized skills for detailed code work.

faq.question: Does it cover Web and Mini Program projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains key platform differences, especially authentication and permission behavior.

faq.question: Can it help with CloudBase console links?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides URL patterns for common CloudBase console management pages.

faq.question: Does it run CloudBase tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives routing guidance and tool selection advice for an agent to apply.

faq.question: Can it prevent deployment failures?
faq.answer: It provides pre-checks for common deployment blockers, but live account state still must be verified.

faq.question: When should I stop using this skill?
faq.answer: Move to a specialized skill once the target service, platform, and implementation path are clear.
